def match(pattern: str, text: str) -> bool:
    """
    Implements regex matching using an iterative approach with two pointers.
    Supports literal characters, '.', '*', and '+'.
    """
    
    p_len = len(pattern)
    t_len = len(text)
    p_idx, t_idx = 0, 0
    star_idx = -1
    match_idx = 0

    while t_idx < t_len:
        if p_idx < p_len and (pattern[p_idx] == text[t_idx] or pattern[p_idx] == '.'):
            p_idx += 1
            t_idx += 1
        elif p_idx < p_len and pattern[p_idx] == '*':
            star_idx = p_idx
            match_idx = t_idx
            p_idx += 1
        elif star_idx != -1:
            p_idx = star_idx + 1
            t_idx = match_idx + 1
            match_idx += 1
        else:
            return False

    while p_idx < p_len and pattern[p_idx] == '*':
        p_idx += 1

    if p_idx < p_len and p_idx + 1 < len(pattern) and pattern[p_idx + 1] == '+':
        return False

    return p_idx == p_len
